title: Great app but pricy
body: I would buy it for 15$ rather than pay 7,99$ a month. Subscription politic good for apps like Spotify. This app is not from this category.
author: Ari Doch

title: It’s great to have support changing and building habits
body: I love this simple and pleasing app. Easy to use and I love the colours, it’s become a staple in my habit forming routine. I look forward to new innovations that I’m sure will come!
author: Taebee

title: Great app
body: Something that’s actually keeping me accountable
author: sassysaphic

title: Easy to use
body:
Great app. Easy to use and understand. Easily customisable. Good visuals for a free app. Great tips provided for creating good habits and keeping them going - currently receiving these via email and with links when setting goals in the app. 
Hasn't asked me to subscribe to anything yet nor has it asked me to pay for 'premium access' so really happy about that. Look forward to progressing with new positive habits! Thank you.
author: Nayskies

title: Love this!
body: I love the colours, more please!
